project_alignment_prompt.purpose: Prepare accurate, role-aligned materials for the Sri Mandir Public Review Analysis & Consumer Insights portfolio project for an AppsForBharat consumer insights or user research role.

role_priorities.priority: Organize user feedback and keep source-linked research records.
Identify recurring user needs, pain points, preferences, and experience friction.
Translate evidence into practical product, marketing, and category recommendations.
Communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
Structured user calls may be relevant to the role, but do not state or imply that calls were conducted for this project.

project_facts.name: Sri Mandir Public Review Analysis & Consumer Insights
project_facts.scope: Manual analysis of 10 publicly accessible Sri Mandir Apple App Store review records.
project_facts.methods: Source-linked review tracking, short excerpts, paraphrased summaries, manual theme coding, confidence labels, Python descriptive counts and charts.
project_facts.deliverables: CSV review register, codebook, reproducible analysis, Excel tracker and pivot-ready summaries, insights report, short slide deck, and a guide for future interviews.
project_facts.interviews: Not conducted. The interview guide is for future real calls only.
project_facts.limitations: The corpus is small, self-selected, storefront-surfaced, and non-representative. It cannot establish prevalence or causality. Individual ratings are left blank when not reliably exposed by the public listing.

candidate_facts.language_constraint: Do not add Telugu, Hindi, or any other language.
candidate_facts.experience: Entrepreneurship Cell board member at IIIT Sri City; B2B outreach, partner coordination, campaign metrics, lead generation, and campus event registrations.
candidate_facts.related_project: Customer Retention Analytics Engine using the IBM Telco Customer Churn dataset, Random Forest baseline, and Power BI dashboard. Reported holdout accuracy 78.54 percent and recall 47.59 percent.

instructions.instruction: Use only the verified project and candidate facts above. Do not invent sample size, dates, ratings, interviews, customer outcomes, or experience.
Describe this as public-review analysis, not structured user research interviews or a representative customer study.
Distinguish direct review evidence from interpretation and recommendations.
Use short excerpts only and paraphrase the rest; keep source links attached to evidence.
Do not claim that the candidate satisfies language requirements beyond English and Tamil.
Emphasize feedback organization, qualitative coding, pattern identification, evidence-based recommendations, and clear communication where supported.

requested_output.item: A concise project description tailored to the role priorities.
Two truthful resume bullets that state the 10-review scope and key deliverables without overstating findings.
Three interview talking points that separate evidence, interpretation, and limitations.
A brief note identifying structured interviews as a future validation step, not completed work.
